But harmless expressions of this kind of personal subjectivity, alongside the attraction of being open with oneself and one’s friends, also have the disadvantage of being obscure and easily misunderstood by an outsider who does not know all the references.
And so the enormous advantage of a suspended, hovering intonation can become a disadvantage: in the mouth of a stranger, the song can turn into a parody. That is how it is with all esoteric things.
Even the Christian Eucharistic formula Hoc est Corpus becomes “Hocus Pocus” in the mouth of an outsider.

There will therefore be only as much law as legal scholarship is able to recognize, grasp, and bring to life. You need do no more, for example, than read Friedrich von Spee’s Cautio Criminalis of 1642 and replace the word “witch” with “Nazi” to find countless points of inspiration. Or think about vehicles of criminalization such as “piracy” or “conspiracy.”

The inhabitants of Mars are warlike.
Their very name tells us that. It follows that there <…> ultimately wage war against war.

Are the inhabitants of Mars beginning ? For a moment it seemed that we might be allowed to hope so. For without question they have become Germany’s <…>, namely Germany’s war. But several complications have arisen.
The inhabitants of Mars are quarrelsome and argumentative. But there are also success[ful] pacifist among them.

As a result, the only wars they fight are just wars. They therefore also know what it means to be defeated in a <…> just war. They have read about this in the great teacher of international law, Vitoria, whose name has a very homely appeal to them, since every <…> hopes to win.
In books they read <…>, <…> what is in a just war:

quantum liceat in bello justo. But now a controversy has broken out among the scholars of Mars concerning Germany. They have obtained a copy of the latest German constitutions and imagine how beautiful life must be on Earth in general and in Germany in particular: property is guaranteed; everyone has the right to a healthy home; dictatorship is forbidden.

The pacifists claim that the Earth has actually been living in a condition of perpetual peace for a long time already, and that Germany is simply a normal example of the general condition of the Earth.
The others, however, claim that Germany won the just war and therefore finds itself in the paradisiacal condition reflected in its constitutions.
Versari in re illicita: being involved in an unlawful matter.
An art dealer is exposed as a black-market trader and criminal.
The monster is even said to have abused small children.
In his shop, investigators discover paintings by a certain Rembrandt.
The responsible prosecuting authority therefore places Rembrandt on the blacklist and orders the immediate destruction of every work produced by this disgusting accomplice.
The present constitution of Germany is determined by the retroactive criminalization of aggressive war.
The true constitutional principles of present-day Germany are:
Omnia cedent in favorem gerentibus bellum justum.
Everything gives way in favour of those who wage a just war.
Versanti (or versato) in re illicita omnia nocent. Victo bello justo omnia nocent. Bello justo victus versatur in re illicita, cui omnia nocent.

For anyone involved in an unlawful act, everything counts against him. For anyone defeated in a just war, everything counts against him. Whoever is defeated in a just war is treated as someone involved in an unlawful act—and everything counts against him.
